name: API-053 - Geo-IP Location Detection API
Description:
Create an endpoint that returns the user's country code based on IP or Cloudflare headers. Expectation: Frontend uses this to route to the correct landing page and set local currency.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoint `GET /api/v1/geo/location` reads `CF-IPCountry` header
- Fallback to MaxMind GeoIP database if header is missing
- Returns JSON: `{ countryCode: 'NG', currency: 'NGN' }`

name: API-054 - Checkout Initialization API (Paystack/Flutterwave/Stripe)
Description:
Create the endpoint to initialize a payment transaction and return the checkout link/access code to the frontend. Expectation: Secure transaction generation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoint `POST /api/v1/checkout/initialize` accepting `eventId` and `userId`
- Calculates correct price based on event settings and user geo
- Calls Stripe/Paystack API to generate a session/access code
- Stores 'PENDING' transaction in the database

name: API-055 - PayGate Shield Webhook Listener (Critical)
Description:
Implement strict, cryptographically secure webhook endpoints to process payment successes (Volume 8). Expectation: Users cannot spoof client-side payment success.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoint `POST /api/v1/webhooks/payment`
- Verifies HMAC SHA512/SHA256 signatures from Paystack/Stripe
- Idempotent processing ensures a webhook fired twice doesn't double-provision access
- Updates Database `Ticket` or `Subscription` status to 'PAID'

name: API-056 - Digital Ticketing Generation Service
Description:
Generate digital PDF receipts and webinar tickets upon successful payment webhook receipt. Expectation: Automated ticket delivery.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PDF generation service rendering ticket with QR Code, Event Name, and Date
- Email integration (SendGrid) dispatching the receipt instantly
- Odoo 19 ERP webhook triggered to log the invoice for accounting (Volume 11)

name: API-057 - Paid Replay & Video Monetization Unlock API
Description:
Endpoint to verify if a user has paid for a replay before delivering the video stream. Expectation: Content protection.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoint `GET /api/v1/replays/{id}/access`
- Checks database if user owns a 'PAID' ticket for the replay
- Generates a short-lived anti-sharing token for the video player if authorized
- Returns 403 Forbidden if not paid
